title: Verify and fix upah kotor formula - use gaji_pokok_aktual, remove duplicate HK koreksi
description: Ensure PayrollCalculator uses gaji_pokok_aktual for upah_kotor calculation. The current formula: upah_kotor = gaji_pokok_aktual + total_tunjangan + total_premi. User reports that koreksi_hk is being accumulated separately even though it's already factored into gaji_pokok_aktual. Need to verify that pot_koreksi is only used for display purposes in komponen_kotor, not added to the base calculation.

files.change: Verify komponen_kotor.subtotal uses gaji_pokok_aktual (not ideal). Verify koreksi is display-only in komponen_kotor and not double-counted.
Review calculateUpahKotor() - already uses gaji_pokok_aktual per line 49-55.

criteria: pot_koreksi is NOT added to komponen_kotor.subtotal (only shown in komponen_kotor.koreksi for display)
